t: A roomier 8-bit Arduino chip that powers the Nano Every.
steps: Buy an Arduino Nano Every from the Arduino store or a maker shop for about 13 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Open the Boards Manager and add the Arduino megaAVR Boards package.
Plug in the board and pick Arduino Nano Every from the board list.
Open the Blink example from the Examples menu.
Click Upload and watch the small light on the board start to blink.
meta: Wild Open. From $12.90. A few stores.
